description: This file defines the CommentsController class which manages comment-related HTTP endpoints such as creating, retrieving, and deleting comments for articles. It uses MediatR for handling requests, integrates with ASP.NET Core routing and authorization, and interacts with comment commands and queries.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: A controller responsible for comment-related API endpoints, including creating, listing, and deleting comments associated with articles identified by slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by id from an article identified by slug.
